hook.text: All four tunes are the trombonist's own, and the longest of them runs past twelve minutes.

facts.label: Recorded
facts.value: 21 November 1963, Van Gelder Studio, Englewood Cliffs

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Grachan Moncur III (trombone), Lee Morgan (trumpet), Jackie McLean (alto saxophone), Bobby Hutcherson (vibes), Bob Cranshaw (double bass), Tony Williams (drums)

sentences.text: Moncur and his compositions were featured on two Jackie McLean albums made for Blue Note in 1963.
Both records explored the same inside and outside approach to music.
